geometry.locator: K2K tutorial page / K2K FAQ page (src:k2k-tutorial-page, src:k2k-faq-page) and site:kamioka-mozumi-mine-super-kamiokande's own sourced coordinate
geometry.note: Not a physical structure: drawn only as the first kilometres of the direction toward Super-Kamiokande, labelled 'inferred direction'. K2K ended in 2004; drawn on the map's underlying timeline via beamline:kek-neutrino's own state_segments (completed).

method: Great-circle initial bearing from geometry:kek-north-counter-hall's own centroid (36.1520276, 140.0722961) toward site:kamioka-mozumi-mine-super-kamiokande's sourced coordinate (36.425722, 137.310306): 277.825 degrees, computed on R = 6 371 008.8 m. Clipped to the map's extent_m (1800 m). site_id left null: no atlas `site:` record exists for the KEK-PS/North-hall location itself (see geometry:kek-north-counter-hall's own notes on that uncertainty).
name: K2K neutrino beam direction toward Super-Kamiokande (inferred)
notes: Computed distance from the North Counter Hall centroid to Super-Kamiokande is 249.41 km, close to (0.2% under) the K2K measurement paper's own quoted 'neutrino flight distance of 250 km' -- reported informationally, not as a formal checks[] row (this near point is only circumstantially, not officially, identified with the KEK-PS North hall -- see geometry:kek-north-counter-hall).

summary.plain: The great-circle direction from KEK toward Super-Kamiokande, 250 km away, along which the K2K neutrino beam travelled from 1999 to 2004.
